standard-dialogue-after-death-plateau.player: Can I buy you a drink?

standard-dialogue-after-death-plateau.npc: Now you're talking! An Asgarnian Ale please!

standard-dialogue-after-death-plateau.text: If the player doesn't have an Asgarnian ale in their inventory:

steps.player: I'll go and get you one.

standard-dialogue-after-death-plateau.text: If the player has an Asgarnian ale in their inventory:

steps.text: You give Harold an Asgarnian ale.
